generalAbilities.name: Interstellar Comms
generalAbilities.description: A remote war machine maintains a constant data link with its pilot, using its pilot's languages and skill modifiers for any unlisted skill. In addition, the pilot can speak through the data link using the remote war machine as a mouthpiece.

defensiveAbilities.name: Corpse Flower
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The war machine would be reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect The war machine self-destructs, dealing 8d6 Electricity Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save) to all creatures in a 60-foot radius. For 1 minute after this ability is used, any creature that touches the war machine's remains is exposed to incredible radiation sickness.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Thermal Shadow
defensiveAbilities.description: 10 feet. The war machine collects and reflects thermal energy to mask its presence. Any creatures targeting the war machine from outside the aura treats it as if it were Concealed unless they possess scent or a non-visual–based sense.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hypersonic Burst
offensiveAbilities.description: The war machine Steps or Strides twice. The war machine gains a +10-foot circumstance bonus to its Speed during these moves.

offensiveAbilities.name: Transmit Memory
offensiveAbilities.description: When a war machine makes an aurora beam Strike against a creature, it absorbs one of the target's memories and remotely transmits the information to its pilot. The target must succeed at a DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw saving throw or become Stupefied 1.
